clean_code.description: The shared body-limit range check now serves DefaultRequest too but still lives on DefaultRestApp, so the request class reaches into the app class for a pure validation helper while the bound itself (MAX_LIMIT) is owned by JsonBodyReader. A static helper next to MAX_LIMIT (e.g. on JsonBodyReader) would keep the check with its constant and avoid the Request -> RestApp dependency. Low priority; optional.
